items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 10 June 2026 10:20pm
items.description:
##Yesterday##

Sunny intervals and scattered showers. Then rain and drizzle later in night, turning persistent and quite heavy.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-7


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

West 10-15, backing South or SW overnight and increasing 15-20, 20-25 in places.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers and in rain and drizzle later. Extensive hill fog later.


##Comments##

Strong winds in places later.


##Today##

Rain and drizzle at first, turning light and patchy later in morning or early afternoon, although staying cloudy. Patchy light rain overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

3-10


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

South or SW 15-20, 20-25 in places, veering West or SW 10-15 during day, 15-20 in places, then increasing 15-20 overnight, 20-25 in places.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor at first. Hill fog, extensive at first.


##Comments##

Strong winds in places at first and later.


##Tomorrow##

Mostly dry with bright or sunny intervals, just a risk of a little patchy light rain for a time. Dry overnight.


##Temperature##
